role: Independent read-only authored-force stage driver review; no edits or physical simulations.
conclusion: No remaining driver implementation blocker found for the declared initial51-cell execution stage, subject to the independently reviewed auditor audit_cell(seal_path,cell_id) interface. No source publication, launch or numerical qualification is inferred by this review.
resolved_findings: Worker completion now requires exactly3*manifestHz planned steps and matching completion, rather than any positive worker-reported count; wrong-length tamper contract test added.

First-cell audit integration now runs exact declared t0001 push_pulse120 cell alone; a pinned independent auditor report with passed=True is mandatory before any subsequent worker starts. False audit persists report/hash, fails the cell and leaves all later cells queued. No extra physical case or modified settings introduced.
review_findings: Each expected publication file is read with git show at an exact40-character commit and compared by SHA256 with current bytes. Commit existence and actual blobs are checked; a local unpublished commit also satisfies this local check, so root remote-publication verification remains a separately established orchestration fact.

Seal, manifest, resources, physical dependencies, runner, auditor and stage driver source are exact-pinned; sources rehashed before each launch/poll cycle and stage completion. Canonical relative paths and runner seal validation bind outputs to the repository and reject stale existing outputs/execution ledgers.

The reviewed resource file enables first-cell audit for exact t0001__push_pulse__temporal__hz120, then at most8 CPU workers. Every child has OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL threads explicitly2. Source driver validates integer max count and exact driver hash; runner independently validates resource types and GPU=false.
Unique manifest cells become one Popen each. There is no retry, replacement or resume path; any existing execution ledger prevents a new launch of the stage.

After observed worker failure no queued cells launch. Already running independent workers are polled to terminal and retain completed/failed records. Stage completed=true requires every exact job completed; queued cells remain visibly unlaunched after failure.

Completion verifies child exit0, exact PID/cell ID, explicit terminal/completed flags,61-frame summary, exact expected steps and complete counts, plus fresh trajectory/step SHA256. First-cell independent audit verifies physical evidence beyond supervisor metadata; full stage auditor remains required for all cells.

Stage exception ledger records driver_error and exact known in-flight process IDs under running_workers_may_remain. Driver terminal status does not falsely assert those children are gone; no hidden termination/restart is attempted.

Atomic JSON replacement and per-worker logs preserve bounded progress and complete raw output locally. Source/proof publication and prospective force-envelope protocol remain separate from numerical success.
optional_comments: Completion hash mismatches can currently produce failed with a null completion_validation_error; recording a short exact mismatch reason would simplify postmortems, while artifacts remain preserved and admission correctly fails.
